candidates.yourNature_desc: You are that sword when it comes down off the doorway and walks around as a person. There's more edge in you than one life has things to cut, so the edge goes looking. The straight answer is out of you before anyone asked, at the kitchen table as easily as at work. Right is not the same as welcome. People keep what you told them and a little distance from the teller.

self_card.face: The drawn blade, nowhere to put it
self_card.presence: Every day the edge is out. You don't decide to be honest, it's already done, and people learn where to stand.

$original.yourNature_desc: You are what the sword is like when it wakes up as a person. The cut is always ready and mostly used. You put the truth ahead of comfort, yours and everyone's, every day, in every setting. People bring you the questions nobody else will answer straight, then flinch at exactly what they asked for. The edge never rests. That includes the nights, and it includes you.

self_card.presence: The cut is always available and mostly used. Clarity this constant is a climate, and the people near you dress for it.

band.yourNature_desc: the sign's sword received onto the reader, Overfueled as more edge than one life has things to cut, the cost paid in company

self_card.face: the Overfueled state as a blade with no sheath to return to
self_card.presence: living as the drawn blade, the cost implied in where people stand
